title: Total influence of a bounded circuit
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be computed by a layered circuit of depth $d$, first-layer width at most $w$, and tail size at most $s'$, where tail size means the number of non-output gates in layers after the first, plus one. Then its total influence, computed using the real-valued sign function, satisfies $\operatorname{Inf}(f)\le 2w\bigl(20(\lceil\log_2(s'+1)\rceil+2)\bigr)^{d-2}$.
hypotheses_covered: There is a Boolean function f
There is a depth circuit computing f
The circuit width is at most w
The tail internal-node count plus one is at most s'
